units: 1 Blender unit = 1 cm = 1 uu; X long side, lock face toward -Y, Z up; FBX_SCALE_UNITS
pivot_notes: lid: origin on the axis of the hinge pins (a line along X at y = 24.6, z = 59.5 in the body frame, measured on the pin cylinders at x = +-45); the whole hinge block (bracket from the pins down the back wall) belongs to the lid. latch: origin on the top edge of the latch block (X axis, mid depth of its top face, x centred); it hangs on the lid front, so in the Blueprint it is a child of the lid.

opening_signs.blender_frame: Lid: rotation about +X of NEGATIVE angle opens it up and backward (lid -105 deg = open; the front, at -Y, goes to +Z). Latch, local, about its top edge: NEGATIVE angle swings its bottom outward (-Y) and up (-90 deg = hasp perpendicular to the lid front face, pointing away from the lid, above the lid front edge when the lid is open).
opening_signs.unreal_mesh_space: The import mirrors Y (hinge at -Y, lid and latch extend toward +Y). Lid component relative Roll NEGATIVE (-105) lifts +Y into +Z (UE Roll is positive when +Y goes toward -Z); Latch relative Roll NEGATIVE (-90). Derived from the mirror and the left-handed rule, not measured in the editor.

manifold_note: edges_over_2_faces are inherited from the Meshy source mesh (27 edges with 3 faces and 6 with 4 in chest_flat.fbx: interpenetrating thin parts); the caps close the open loops

open_edges_note: 26 / 36 / 33 open edges remain on body / lid / latch: tiny cracks at junctions of the Meshy source (51 open edges in chest_flat.fbx) and non-simple loops the hole fill skips; none is visible in the renders

renders.camera: ortho 170, target (0,0,33), 500 cm, EEVEE, one sun 4.0 rotated (50,10,-60), world 0.85 at 0.6 (the cut_* renders of 306-02)
renders.poses: closed = identity; latch released = latch -60 about X; open = lid -105 about X at the pin axis, latch child of the lid with -90 local; cut_openwide* = wide camera (ortho 260, target (0,20,70)); cut_openwide100 / cut_openwide115 = lid -100 / -115

open_pose_note: latch_min_z_minus_its_pivot_z is the no-dangling check: the lowest latch point is its own top edge (0 to -2.4 cm, its thickness), so nothing hangs below the hinge line. The latch top edge sits 6.5 cm behind the lid front face and 10 cm above its bottom edge, so it is 7 to 12 cm below the lid front-bottom edge in world z. The pins are at the top rear of the lid (z 59.5), 18 cm above the seam: opened about them the lid hovers 9 to 12 cm above the body rim (clearance_lid_over_body_rim), it never touches the body.
